test_gtn_equal: test the gtn.equal function to compare two graphs for structural and label equality
test_gtn_isomorphic: test the gtn.isomorphic function to check if two graphs have the same structure regardless of node indexing
test_gtn_loadtxt: test the gtn.loadtxt function to load a graph from a text file format with start and accept node declarations
test_gtn_savetxt: test the gtn.savetxt function to write a graph to a text file with arc labels and weights
test_gtn_loadsave: test the gtn.save and gtn.load functions to serialize and deserialize graphs in binary format
